title: J. Willard Gibbs: Scientific Papers Volume I, Old-Physics Modern LaTeX Working Editions
version: 2026-06-14 pending Gibbs Volume I Paper 3 continuation through printed page 134
description:
Dedicated old-physics author record for source-scan-backed modern LaTeX working editions of selected material from J. Willard Gibbs, The Scientific Papers of J. Willard Gibbs, Volume I.

Current public coverage: pp. 001-032, Graphical Methods in the Thermodynamics of Fluids; pp. 033-054, A Method of Geometrical Representation of the Thermodynamic Properties of Substances by Means of Surfaces; and pp. 055-124, the opening continuation of On the Equilibrium of Heterogeneous Substances. Local pending staging adds GibbsV1_P3_p125_134.zip, extending Paper 3 to printed pp.125-134 and cumulative pp.055-134 with TeX/PDF/source scan, formula/table/scan-map ledgers, compile QC, and repair log. This is continuous for the currently staged Volume I tranche through printed page 134 once the pending package is uploaded, but it is not a complete edition of all Gibbs scientific papers.

Source-quality refresh: a local 2026-06-14 audit found and recorded better image-level witnesses: IA raw JP2/scandata for the 1906 Scientific Papers Vols. I-II and a separate processed-JP2/PDF witness for On the Equilibrium of Heterogeneous Substances. Future continuation should use those image-level witnesses, not only derivative PDFs or small page-slice PDFs.

Work level: source-scan-backed working LaTeX drafts. The top-level PDFs and TeX files are reader-facing cumulative surfaces. The ZIP packets preserve editable TeX, source-scan slices, and local method/audit files for each covered tranche. OCR is used as a witness layer only; the source scan remains authoritative for formulae, notation, figures, tables, and final proofreading.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Dedicated Gibbs / old-physics DOI. Current public release exposes reader-facing PDF/TeX surfaces and compact source-scan ZIP packets for Volume I through printed page 124. Pending local upload GibbsV1_P3_p125_134.zip extends Paper 3 to printed pp.125-134 and cumulative pp.055-134 with clean compile QC and formula/table/scan-map ledgers. Source-quality refresh 2026-06-14 records IA raw JP2/scandata for the 1906 Scientific Papers volumes and a separate Equilibrium witness for future continuation. Continue after p.134 once uploaded/promoted. Do not treat this as a complete edition of the full Gibbs corpus.
